title: Experiment run metadata v1
description: Ground truth for one fault-injection run. Written by the harness, never edited to make a run look better; an invalid run is kept with valid=false and a reason. Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339.

run_id.description: Unique run id, stable across exports and analysis.

fault_id.description: Fault catalogue id, e.g. F01. See docs/FAULT_MATRIX.md.

seed.description: Random seed used by the injector/workload, when applicable.

target.description: Injection target, e.g. aiops-test/shop-demo or the worker node name.

t_impact.description: Time the first user-visible impact was observed, or null if none.

t_detection.description: Time the system raised the corresponding event/incident, or null if it never did.

t_verified_recovery.description: Time independent verification confirmed recovery, or null.

variant.description: Configuration variant under test, e.g. ml-b2 or rca-b1.

config_hash.description: Hash of the effective configuration for this run.

component_versions.description: Versions of the components involved (detector, processor, connector, central, K3s, model package as applicable).

valid.description: Whether the run is usable for evaluation. Invalid runs stay in the dataset with a reason.

invalid_reason.description: Required when valid=false; must be null when valid=true.
